title: Kenyan Ham Satay with Spicy Peanut Sauce
description: A fusion of Kenyan and Thai flavors, these satay skewers are marinated in a mix of spices and grilled to perfection, served with a creamy spicy peanut sauce.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine peanuts, coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Blend until smooth.
Heat the peanut sauce in a saucepan over medium heat until warm and fragrant.
In a large bowl, whisk together honey, lime juice, and fish sauce. Add the sliced Kenyan ham and toss to coat.
Soak 20 bamboo skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated ham onto the skewers.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the ham is cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the skewers with the spicy peanut sauce for dipping.
